paper_title: Searching for axion-like particles with ultra-peripheral heavy-ion collisions
coupling_convention: 1/Lambda in GeV^-1 (note: this is the aFF coupling 1/Lambda, related to g_agamma by a factor)
notes: Paper presents projected sensitivity (1 nb^-1 and 10 nb^-1 Pb-Pb UPC) and recast limits (OPAL, ATLAS, CMS) for ALP-photon coupling 1/Lambda vs ma (5-100 GeV). Coupling is ALP-photon (aFF and aBB operators). However, all results are presented only graphically in Fig. 4; no numerical tables or explicit text values of the exclusion curves are provided, so no reliable (mass, coupling) pairs could be extracted. Note convention: the y-axis is 1/Lambda where La = -(1/4)(a/Lambda)F~F, which differs from the standard g_agamma by a factor (g_agamma = 1/Lambda in this convention). | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Left panel of Fig 4, aF-tilde-F coupling. Y-axis is 1/Lambda (GeV^-1), interpreted as g_agamma. Traced the green solid curve (Pb-Pb 1 nb^-1 projected sensitivity), which is the lower boundary in the background-relevant region 5-100 GeV. The x-axis has a log section below 5 GeV and linear above; data points sampled in the linear region. The 10 nb^-1 dashed curve sits a factor ~2-3 lower.
